can: Consigo falar de filmes e séries, explicar como algo é feito ou aconteceu usando a voz passiva, e recomendar um filme.

lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Cinema (plot, cast, scene, sequel, trailer, review, subtitles, special effects).

aula.text: **Verbos:** shoot ou film (filmar), star in (estrelar), release (lançar).

items: "I assisted a great film." Assist quer dizer ajudar. O certo é **I watched a great film.**
"The film is based in a true story." O certo é based **on**.

Yesterday I assisted a great film.
acc: Yesterday I watched a great film

acc: The film is based on a true story

lessons.title: Voz passiva
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Voz passiva em vários tempos (presente, passado, present perfect, futuro, com modais).

aula.text: Forma: **be + particípio**. A passiva foca na ação ou no resultado, não em quem fez. Use *by* só quando quem fez é importante: *The film was directed by Spielberg.*

head: Tempo
Forma
Exemplo
rows: The film is shown every night.
The film was shot in Chile.
It will be released next year.

aula.label: Atenção
aula.text: verbos que não têm objeto não têm passiva (happen, arrive, die, go).

items: "The film was shoot in Chile." O certo é **was shot** (particípio, não infinitivo).
"The accident was happened yesterday." O certo é **The accident happened yesterday.**
"Many films are making in Brazil." O certo é **are made**.

exercises.prompt: This series ___ (watch) by millions of people every week.
Many films are making in Brazil.
acc: Many films are made in Brazil

lessons.title: Inglês prático, recomendar um filme
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Recomendar e comentar um filme ou série.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: You should watch... / I'd recommend... / It's well worth watching. / You'll love it.
Have you seen...? / What's it about? / Is it any good? / Who's in it?
It was gripping. / It was a bit predictable. / The ending was disappointing. / The acting was brilliant.
No spoilers, please! / I won't give anything away.
I thought so too. / I didn't like it as much as you.

items: "I recommend you to watch it." O certo é **I recommend watching it** ou **You should watch it.**
"The film was great, I loved." O certo é **I loved it.** (em inglês o objeto é obrigatório)

exercises.prompt: ___ you seen the new Brazilian series?
I recommend you to watch this film.
The film was great, I loved.
acc: The film was great, I loved it

exercises.prompt: Peça para não contarem o final.
